sections.content: You know *porque* and *por eso* (A2 Unit 5), *debido a* (B1 Unit 6) and *así que* (B1 Unit 1). Here you use them to explain city problems through connected causes and effects. A B1 explanation should make clear not only what the problem is, but why it happens and what it causes.

items.spanish: Hay demasiados coches, por eso hay más contaminación.
items.english: There are too many cars, so there is more pollution.

items.spanish: Debido al tráfico, los autobuses llegan tarde con frecuencia.
items.english: Because of the traffic, buses frequently arrive late.

items.spanish: Hay mucho ruido en la zona, así que algunos vecinos quieren mudarse.
items.english: There is a lot of noise in the area, so some neighbours want to move.

items.spanish: El transporte público es limitado, y por eso muchas personas utilizan el coche.
items.english: Public transport is limited, so many people use the car.

sections.content: Por *eso* and *así* *que* normally introduce a consequence. Porque and *debido* a introduce a cause. Use them to build an explicit chain from problem to explanation to result.
